script.name: Menu.PC
script.description: Menu: Main menu on special reports

line.comment: * Add-Ons 2.0.1: Cleaned up. Bounty Board is now hidden for OCV players.
* ZH 2.0 allows to manage all sectors from anywhere
* add non selectable menu item: $MainMenu, text=$t
* Add-Ons 2.1.2: Cannot purchase ships on insane difficulty.
* ZH 2.0 evil ending - no more upkeep costs
* Expanded 2.2: Jobs are unavailable after joining the OCV.

line.text: 'Register this ship as a Cargo Hauler'
'Unregister this ship as a Cargo Hauler'

line.comment: * Add-Ons 1.13: Move autosave and auto recycle tug toggles here. Get colored ON/OFF buttons from Cycrow Menu, ID 9999.
* Add-Ons 1.13: Hide the debug menu if not in developer mode.
* add custom menu item to array $MainMenu: text='Destroy Raiders' returnvalue='DestroyRaiders'
* Mordan9 - Shows a factions' raiders on Ministry of War screen.

line.text: 'Taxi registration is unavailable after joining the OCV.'
'You must pilot a TP to register as a taxi.'

line.comment: * Expanded 2.2 (ported from FoF): Should never happen because CLS is equipped on all ships.

line.text: 'No life support aboard. Fit a Cargo Lifesupport System at an Outpost hangar before registering as a taxi.'
'Upgrading your taxi will double your income.'
'Cargo Hauler registration is unavailable after joining the OCV.'
'You must pilot a TS to register as a cargo hauler.'
'You must be registered as a cargo hauler to access this manifest.'
'The debug section will be permanently hidden. Continue?'
